description: Reference weather files redistributed for offline demonstration and testing. Each file is an NREL TMY3 typical meteorological year in EnergyPlus EPW format, taken from the EnergyPlus source repository (weather/ directory). A TMY splices representative months from different calendar years (generally 1973-2005; per-month source years are recorded in each dataset's provenance). TMY data represent typical conditions and understate extremes; they are not a single observed year.
dataset_citation: Wilcox, S. and Marion, W. (2008). Users Manual for TMY3 Data Sets. NREL/TP-581-43156. National Renewable Energy Laboratory, Golden, CO.
licence: TMY3 data were produced by NREL for the US Department of Energy and are publicly available. The EnergyPlus repository is distributed under the EnergyPlus licence (BSD-3-Clause-style). Verify terms before commercial redistribution.
checksums: SHA256SUMS lists the SHA-256 of the uncompressed .epw files; the .epw.gz files in this directory are gzip -9 of those files.
